fuse_conv_affine: fuse Conv and AffineChannel ops in a Caffe2 net to optimize the model graph
filter_ops: filter Caffe2 operators by type, inputs, or outputs using the OpFilter class
generate_init_net: generate a Caffe2 initialization net from a dictionary of numpy blob tensors
compare_models: compare two Caffe2 models by running them on a test image and checking blob outputs
save_model_graph: save a Caffe2 net as a PNG graph visualization using pydot
